name: Electro / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A sharp bone and tendon crack combined with a high-voltage whip, followed by uneven sparking arcs and a sustained rough electrical discharge that winds down. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
